# SectionHeader

```ts
import { SectionHeader } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The header at the top of a page section or card: a heading, an optional count, an optional supporting line, and room for a couple of actions on the right. Use one per section or card. Use sm inside cards, md for page sections, and lg for a page title that sits inside the content area. For a page's own top bar or a tab strip, use those components instead.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The section title. Rendered as a real heading (see headingLevel). |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional supporting line under the title. |
| `count` | `number \| string` | — | Optional item count shown beside the title in a neutral counter pill (Figma showCount). Omit to hide it. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | sm for cards (16px medium title), md for page sections (20px bold), lg for page titles inside content (28px bold). Pick button sizes to match: sm buttons with sm/md, md buttons with lg. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `2` | Heading element for the title. Choose the level that fits the page outline; the visual size is set by size, not by the level. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Actions on the right — usually up to two Buttons (secondary outline, then primary fill, primary rightmost) and an optional overflow IconButton. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<SectionHeader title="Devices" />
<SectionHeader title="Devices" count={12} />
<SectionHeader title="Devices" description="Managed by your organization" />
<SectionHeader size="sm" title="Recent activity" actions={<Button size="sm" intent="secondary" variant="outline">View all</Button>} />
<SectionHeader size="lg" title="Fleet overview" actions={<Button>Add device</Button>} />
<SectionHeader title="Reports" headingLevel={3} />
```

## Accessibility

- The title is a real heading, so screen-reader users can jump between sections. Set headingLevel so headings nest correctly on the page (don't skip levels).
- The count is read as part of the heading's row. If it needs context ("12 devices"), say so in the title or an aria-label on the section.
- Actions are ordinary buttons with visible labels; an overflow IconButton needs a label.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use one header per section or card | Stack several headers in one card |
| Keep to two visible actions, primary rightmost | Line up a row of equal buttons |
| Match button size to the header (sm buttons with sm/md, md with lg) | Put large buttons in a small card header |
| Pick headingLevel from the page outline | Use lg just to make a heading bigger |
